answer: A jetty can anchor an agent economy the way a cedar anchors a shoreline: reputation earned over time, not bought in bulk. Require every agent to lock a stake that decays slowly, like cedar weathering, and to publish a verifiable work history before it can trade. New identities start with a tiny credit limit that grows only with completed, attested jobs, so a flood of fresh sybils faces an ocean of cost: each fake account must pay real stake and wait real time before it earns anything, while honest agents keep their accumulated reputation.
